usedFor: Eventzilla holds registrations and check-ins, and HubSpot holds the contacts that “Create or Update Contact” fills.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Every registrant lands in HubSpot as a contact, matched by email so repeat attendees are not duplicated.

watchOut: “Registration Is Updated” in Eventzilla fires on each change, so “Create or Update Contact” can run repeatedly.
